briefings.title: The Changing Physics of Cybersecurity and Drug Development with OpenAI President Greg Brockman
briefings.channel: No Priors: AI, Machine Learning, Tech, & Startups
briefings.tldr: OpenAI President and co-founder Greg Brockman discusses the rollout of GPT-6 to over a billion people, the resolution of nearly 400 century-old math problems by AI agents, and how proactive AI tools like "Dots" are transforming productivity and the future of work.

briefings.title: Beam: The Great American Open Model with ReflectionAI Co-Founder and CEO Misha Laskin
briefings.channel: No Priors: AI, Machine Learning, Tech, & Startups
briefings.tldr: ReflectionAI CEO Misha Laskin discusses the launch of Beam—a 500 billion parameter (23B active) open-weight reasoning model—explaining how the company scaled end-to-end pre-training and reinforcement learning to build a Western frontier open model that achieves 3x–4x greater reasoning efficiency than peers.

briefings.title: Coinbase’s Everything Exchange: Agentic Finance, Stablecoins & Tokenization with CEO Brian Armstrong
briefings.channel: No Priors: AI, Machine Learning, Tech, & Startups
briefings.tldr: Coinbase co-founder and CEO Brian Armstrong details Coinbase's evolution into the "Everything Exchange" via tokenized real-world assets, explosive stablecoin payments, and agentic finance (AIFI) tools for AI agents.

briefings.title: Redefining Chip Architecture with Arm CEO Rene Haas
briefings.channel: No Priors: AI, Machine Learning, Tech, & Startups
briefings.tldr: Arm CEO Rene Haas discusses how Arm is positioned at the epicenter of AI-driven compute demands, transitioning from an IP licensing model to physical chip production (such as the Arm AGI CPU for Meta) while navigating supply chain constraints, semiconductor manufacturing independence, and the future of robotics and edge AI.

briefings.title: Rethinking Legacy Data Infrastructure with Eon Co-Founders Ofir Ehrlich and Gonen Stein
briefings.channel: No Priors: AI, Machine Learning, Tech, & Startups
briefings.tldr: Eon co-founders Ofir Ehrlich and Gonen Stein discuss how Eon is redefining cloud backup into a secure data foundation that helps enterprises map, classify, and ingest scattered historical data to power AI workflows while defending against rogue AI agents.

briefings.title: Build 2026 Podcast: Satya Nadella, Sarah Guo and Elad Gil from No Priors, and Swyx from Latent Space
briefings.tldr: AI value is shifting from raw foundation models to an ecosystem-driven "harness" layer where enterprises use private evaluations and custom agentic workflows to hill-climb performance.

briefings.title: The AI Frontier and How to Spot Billion-Dollar Companies Before Everyone Else — Elad Gil
briefings.tldr: The AI landscape is currently defined by a "personal IPO" for top talent and a temporary compute ceiling caused by memory bottlenecks, creating a unique two-year window of market parity and a critical 12-18 month exit opportunity for non-durable startups.

briefings.title: The history and future of AI at Google, with Sundar Pichai
briefings.tldr: Google is aggressively scaling its AI infrastructure with an anticipated $175B–$185B CAPEX budget for 2026, transitioning its core products from search interfaces to "agent managers" while navigating a global supply crunch in memory, wafers, and power.

briefings.title: No Priors Ep. 80 | With Andrej Karpathy from OpenAI and Tesla
briefings.channel: No Priors: AI, Machine Learning, Tech, & Startups
briefings.tldr: Andrej Karpathy discusses the parallels between self-driving car development and AGI, Tesla's transition to end-to-end neural networks for cars and humanoid robots, and his new venture Eureka Labs, which aims to scale expert teaching using AI-driven front-ends.
